payload.text: **Sweep pre-notice, behaviour changes to call out by name (not just list files):** (1) every gated tool now reads no input (lib/runlog, 0088 row 2) -- a gate that prompted at a person's terminal now fails as it does in CI; a command needing the terminal must drop `log:`. (2) 0087: `--purge`/`--purge-only`/`--allow-empty` at a command-level gate now reach the gate, not the tool. (3) 0086: replace of a read-only file no longer blocks at a terminal. Feeds todo 58.
